description: This Dart source file contains a utility function designed to initialize the sqflite FFI implementation for testing purposes. It sets up the database factory for unit and widget tests to prevent hanging issues due to unavailable platform implementations.

methods.name: initSqfliteFfiForTests
methods.description: Initializes the sqflite FFI implementation for testing by calling sqfliteFfiInit and assigning databaseFactory to databaseFactoryFfi.
